feeds.title: Write Along with Me
feeds.description: I started this blog in spring 2010 to center around the fall publication of my career memoir, Caring Lessons A Nursing Professor's Journey of Faith and Self. Since June of 2012, my goal has been to blog, from the perspective of a retired nurse, on writing, growing older, and living in Chicago.

feeds.title: Carrie Dameron Blog
feeds.description: A nurse encouraging Christians on their faith journey. My passion has been to encourage Christian nurses in living out their faith in professional practice. Through articles, devotions, and books, I have encouraged Christian nurses on their faith journey since 2008.

feeds.title: Juliana's Heaven's Clarion Blog
feeds.description: Find articles featuring Just About Everything In My Heart; Health, Heaven And More. Hello there! I'm Juliana, A Devout Christian, A Registered Nurse, A Songwriter, A Singer, A Dance Minister, A Crazy Fashionista, A Sports Enthusiast, And One Who Loves To Write. Juliana's Blog Features Posts Which Are Highly Influenced By My Christian Faith And My Nursing Profession, Alongside My Very Expressive Fields Of Interest.

feeds.title: Jennie Johnson RN Blog
feeds.description: Explore her life stories and experiences along with health advice for cardiac health in the blog. Jennie Johnson, RN-BC, PhD spent the first half of her nursing career taking care of heart attack and stroke patients and the second half preventing them.

feeds.title: The Heart of Nursing Blog » Christian Nursing
feeds.description: Reflections on the Joys, Struggles, and Meaning in Nursing. Find Posts about Christian nursing written by Hui-wen (Alina) Sato, a pediatric intensive care unit (PICU) nurse since 2010.

feeds.title: Pamela's Nursing Reflections
feeds.description: Follow this blog as Pamela shares useful lessons, information and advice to encourage Christian nurses, nursing students, and those considering entering nursing. My goal is to encourage other Christian nurses, nursing students, and those considering entering nursing by sharing the lessons God has taught me about Himself.

feeds.title: Nurse Lionella Blog
feeds.description: A blog featuring articles on Christianity, Life Experience, Education, Nursing. Lionella Betts-MacCormack also known as Nurse Lionella is first and foremost a Follower of Jesus Christ, a Wife, a Mother, a Sister, a Friend, a Registered Nurse Leader, an Aspiring Non-Fiction Author, Blogger, and Educator.

feeds.title: Brie Gowen
feeds.description: Read articles depicting the daily life of a Christian nurse and mother. Brie is a forty-something wife and mother. When she's not loving on her hubby or playing with her three daughters, she enjoys cooking, reading, and writing down her thoughts to share with others. She loves traveling the country with her family in their fifth wheel, and all the Netflix binges in between.

feeds.title: Nurses Christian Fellowship Blog
feeds.description: The Purpose of Nurses Christian Fellowship, as a ministry of InterVarsity Christian Fellowship/USA, is to establish and advance in nursing, within education and practice, witnessing communities of nursing students and nurses who follow Jesus as Savior and Lord. Christian nursing is a ministry of compassionate care for the whole person, in response to God's grace toward a sinful world, which aims to foster optimum health (shalom) and bring comfort in suffering and death for anyone in need.
